name: Gunforce 2 Vita
author: Tobic-99
description: A static recompilation of Gunforce 2 (Irem, 1994, M92 arcade board) to native ARM code. The game's V33 main program is translated to C++ and linked with a native runtime that replaces the board: memory map, interrupt controller, DMA, a software video renderer, and the sound board (V35 with Irem's opcode encryption, YM2151 and GA20). The sound CPU runs in an interpreter.
